name: [⚔️😇 UPD] My Battle Cat Army
desc:
⚔️ Welcome to My Battle Cat Army! ⚞◉⏖◉⚟

Build your battle cat army, command and dominate the battlefield now! 

The farther you go, the richer you will become.

❓ How to Play
1. Place battle cats on the field wisely.
2. Attack!
3. Defeat enemies by battle cats and spells.
4. Unlock better cats with coins 

==We will launch new cats on each 100 Likes! ==
